82 Cute Aesthetic School Supplies You Don’t Have To Be A Student To Love
Home
Aug 18 
Written By Ashley Rollins

This page may contain affiliate links.  We may earn a small commission for any purchases made through these links. 

Making a list of what you need for the classroom can feel like a never-ending task. Between pens, highlighters, and notebooks (not to mention everything that holds these school supplies), there is just so much to choose from. 

And, who said that matching school supplies and fun desk accessories were just for students? Not us! In fact, having an aesthetic office can actually make you more productive when it feels like a space that you actually want to be in. Adding a hint of color or a unique organizational system is a simple—and often budget-friendly—way to give your desk a little upgrade and a lot of personality. 

Whether you’re going back to college, sending a kid to school, a teacher making the classroom colorful and fun, or prepping for a busy quarter at work, you’ll want these aesthetic school supplies.

Best Pens, Markers, & Highlighters

Perhaps second only to a new computer, pens, pencils, and highlighters are at the top of the back to school shopping list. They’re also one of the most affordable swaps that you can make if your desk is lacking some pizzazz or if you just want a little something to make you smile. This can only mean one thing—a huge list of our favorite aesthetic writing utensils. 

Image: Amazon

Quick Drying Gel Pens
Ddaowanx

Even though many of us turn to our laptops for writing, nothing beats a good ol’ gel pen gliding across the page. These quick-drying black pens are just as cute as they are functional.

Shop Now

Image: Amazon

Mechanical Pencil Set
Four Candies

Why is it that only pens get all of the attention? This set has everything that you need for the entire school year—mechanical pencils, lead refills, and erasers!

Shop Now

Image: Amazon

Highlighter And Pen Matching Set
BLIEVE

We love a matching aesthetic, so it’s no surprise that we would match our writing utensils! This set has a variety of pastel-colored highlighters with matching ink pens for a fully on-brand note-taking experience. 

Shop Now

Image: Amazon

Crystal & Diamond Pen Set
WeMate

These pens were made for the days when you’re embodying your inner Elle Woods.

Shop Now

Image: Amazon

Vintage Fine Point Ink Pens
Taja

These retro-inspired pens have a black gel ink for those who love writing with a fine point. The soft grip makes them comfortable enough to use in the classes that require taking a lot of notes. Plus, they come in black, blue, or colored ink. 

Shop Now

Image: Amazon

Mildliner Double Edged Highlighters
Zebra Pen

When you can’t decide what kind of highlighter you need, might we suggest a double-sided version? With one end that has a flat chisel tip, and another that has a thicker bullet tip, you can write (or highlight) to your heart’s content!

Colorful No-Smear Ink Pens
Mr. Pen

No black ink here! This set of 10 colorful ink pens is perfect for taking notes in class or just doodling in the margins. Each pen also has no-smear, no bleed ink, making them useful on just about any paper or notepad.

Shop Now

Image: Etsy

Resin Floral Pens
Everything Is Ok

These pressed flower ink pens not only look chic, but they’ll be a comfortable addition to your writing collection. 

Shop Now

Image: Etsy

Heart Mini Pencils
Inklings Paperie

No, these aren’t the mini pencils that you know from mini golf or IKEA! These short pencils are perfect for whenever you want to jot down a quick note or when you’re keeping your school supplies to a minimum.

Image: Amazon

Pastel Highlighters
Mr. Pen

If you’re not a bright color person, don’t fret, because these pastel highlighters come in an array of colors that will help you mark the important things that need your attention. Plus, the fun rectangular shape will save some space in your already overflowing pencil case.

Image: Amazon

Transparent Sticky Note Pen
Diversebee

If you’re writing on transparent sticky notes, this pen is a must to make sure that any important reminders don’t smear onto the page. While there are many similar pen variations available, we’ve found that this one is the best!

Best Notebooks & Stationary

The classic notebook. Whether you prefer large or small, wide- or college-ruled, a vast selection of stationary is a must-have when it comes to going back to school (or work). The easiest way to make sure that you take great notes in class? Having a fun notebook that you want to write in!

Best Planners & To-Do Lists

A tale as old as time, a great planner can be a make-or-break necessity for school. If you struggle with deadlines, due dates, and class schedules, this is one section that you don’t want to scroll by. 

Image: Amazon

To Do List & Daily Planner
Zicoto

Monthly and weekly planners are great, but I turn to my daily to-do lists more than anything. This planner combines the best of both worlds by giving you a daily planner layout with space for appointments, notes, reminders, and tasks. 

Shop Now

Image: Amazon

Budget Planner
Clever Fox

A whole pad to remind you of everything that you need to do. Today. Tomorrow. And the day after that.

Image: Amazon

Russel + Hazel

This isn’t your typical white dry-erase board. This clear, acrylic board is a fun way to write encouraging notes, affirmations, or upcoming assignments in an unexpected, stylish, and trendy way.

Image: Amazon

Yop & Tom

The Fruitful Entrepreneur

Best School Supply & Paper Organizers

Sure, it’s great to have supplies, but where are you going to put the supplies? Whether you need to store your school stuff at your desk or in your room, or you need to be able to take them with you, these organizers are another must-have on our school supply list. 

Image: Amazon

Large Capacity Pencil Case
WeMate

You need a place to keep all of those writing utensils, and this cute and giant pencil case can fit all of your pens, notes, highlighters, and probably even a calculator. It also comes in every color to match your personal style.

Image: Amazon

Decorative File Folders
New Generation

Goodbye to the flimsy paper folders that we all had in elementary school. These laminated folders are a worthy upgrade to protect important essays, assignments, and papers to make sure that they’re ready by the due date. 

Shop Now

Image: Amazon

5 Pocket Folder With Labels
Sooez

Whether it’s notes for class or receipts for your budget, this expandable file folder helps to maximize limited space and keep everything perfectly organized. 

Shop Now

Best Sticky Notes, Stickers, & Labels

Sticky notes and labels are like the cherry on top of a sundae. While you might not need them, it does make everything just a little bit better. In this case, we love sticky notes for their aesthetic vibes just as much as we do for their utility. 

Image: Amazon

Pastel Sticky Note Set
Hommie

There are a lot of sticky notes on this list—seriously, though, they’re the definition of aesthetic—but this is the comprehensive set. With a variety of sizes, colors, and even page tabs, you won’t need any other notes. (That is, unless you want to.) 

Shop Now

Image: Amazon

Pop-Up Note Dispenser
Post-It

One part desk accessory, but one part adorable kitty. Who wouldn’t reach for one when it’s there to help? 

Shop Now

Image: Amazon

Transparent Sticky Notes
Diversebee

Move over standard notes! These transparent sticky tabs are perfect to use in textbooks or notebooks to write yourself a note and still be able to see the text underneath. Not only that, but the thin PET-material is waterproof!

Note: Traditional pens will smudge on these, so make sure to snag the sticky note marker we recommended on this list above.

Shop Now

Image: Amazon

Colorful Grid Sticky Notes

For your lunch-note love notes, quick to-do reminders, or an affirmation to get you through a hectic week, these cute, unique sticky notes are a must-have.

Shop Now

Image: Amazon

Washi Tape
Knaid

It’s simple—washi tape just makes things more fun. Put a strip in your notes to emphasize an important quiz question, mark an important date, or just use it for decoration. 

Shop Now

Image: Amazon

Decorative Stickers For Planners
HZMM

When washi tape isn’t enough, turn to stickers. These stickers come in all of the green, pink, brown, yellow, and purple hues you could ever desire. Use them in your planner, on your calendar, or to hang up cute notes on the wall. Either way, these multi-purpose adhesives are essential.

Shop Now

Pastel Correction Tape

Who needs boring white out correction pens when these are so much better? (Note: The correction tape is white, not colored.)

Shop Now

Image: Amazon

Inkless Label Maker
Niimbot

Best Desk Accessories

They say that the key to studying is having a great desk space. Keep all of your school things and stationary organized and tucked away so that you can focus on that homework that’s due tomorrow. 

Image: Amazon

Colorful Wireless Keyboard
UBOTIE

Give your desk a glow-up with a colorful wireless keyboard. Not only do they come in a bunch of cute colors, but the sound and sensations of the keys feel like an old typewriter. Everyone will be asking you where you got this desk accessory.

Sweetfull

Compact Travel Mirror

Whether you’re taking a break from your desk or you’re working from your bed in your dorm, this cushioned lap desk provides the perfect place to use your computer or tablet, with a convenient cupholder to prevent spilling that cup of coffee you so desperately need during your all nighter.

Best Backpacks & Totes

So just how will you get your school supplies to and from the classroom? Well, that depends, but we suggest having a quality backpack or tote to carry around your necessities. And no, it doesn’t have to look like you just stepped out of class—many of these backpacks and bags are upgraded takes on the classics. 

Image: Target

Signature Commuter Backpack
Open Story

A sleek backpack that doesn’t immediately say high school or college student? Yes, please! 

Shop Now

Image: Amazon

2-In-1 Quilted Metro Tote

This woman-designed tote is perfect for just about anything—work, travel, school, and everything in between! Its 18”x 14”x 6” dimensions mean that it can hold up to a 17” laptop and with a built-in thermal insulated pocket, it can hold your lunch, too.

For the student that just needs a super functional, yet chic laptop bag for class, this bag accommodates up to a 14” laptop, with a soft lining that keeps your computer safe and sound. Additional pockets on the inside allow for easy access to pens, pencils, and other important tools, while a shoulder strap provides a comfortable carry between buildings.
